key: NOEL: Should I check the path now?
en: NOEL: Should I check the path now?
ja: ノエル: 今、経路を確認しようか?

key: NOEL: Okay. Wait here.
en: NOEL: Okay. Wait here.
ja: ノエル: わかった。ここで待ってて。

key: NOEL: This is correct. The train can reach the exit now.
en: NOEL: This is correct. The train can reach the exit now.
ja: ノエル: これで正解だ。列車は出口まで進めるようになった。

key: ANNA: You did it~
en: ANNA: You did it~
ja: アンナ: やったね~

key: Nostra says congrats, you two!
en: Nostra says congrats, you two!
ja: ノストラも、二人ともおめでとうって言ってる!

key: Ow--
en: Ow--
ja: いたっ――

key: NOEL: Anna?
en: NOEL: Anna?
ja: ノエル: アンナ?

key: ANNA: I'm okay! I just slipped.
en: ANNA: I'm okay! I just slipped.
ja: アンナ: 大丈夫! ちょっと滑っただけ。

key: C-c'mon, let's get going!
en: C-c'mon, let's get going!
ja: さ、さあ、行こう!

key: NOEL: This combination doesn't work.
en: NOEL: This combination doesn't work.
ja: ノエル: この組み合わせじゃダメだ。

key: ANNA: That's okay. We just have to keep trying until we find one that does.
en: ANNA: That's okay. We just have to keep trying until we find one that does.
ja: アンナ: 大丈夫。うまくいく組み合わせが見つかるまで、試し続けるだけだから。

key: We should have plenty of time...
en: We should have plenty of time...
ja: 時間はたっぷりあるはずだし……

key: NOEL: Okay.
en: NOEL: Okay.
ja: ノエル: わかった。

key: ANNA: All you have to do is arrange the switches and find a path so this train can go from where it is now to the exit, right?
en: ANNA: All you have to do is arrange the switches and find a path so this train can go from where it is now to the exit, right?
ja: アンナ: スイッチを並べ替えて、この列車が今の場所から出口まで行ける経路を見つければいいだけだよね?

key: NOEL: Without stopping.
en: NOEL: Without stopping.
ja: ノエル: 止まらずに、だ。

key: ANNA: Right! Because Charlotte doesn't care about brakes.
en: ANNA: Right! Because Charlotte doesn't care about brakes.
ja: アンナ: そう! シャルロットはブレーキなんて気にしないから。

key: Don't worry, my heart is telling me there's definitely a way out of here!
en: Don't worry, my heart is telling me there's definitely a way out of here!
ja: 心配しないで、あたしの心が、絶対にここから出る道があるって教えてくれてるから!

key: Or at least that's prooobably why it feels so weird right now?
en: Or at least that's prooobably why it feels so weird right now?
ja: というか、たぶんそれが理由で、今すごく変な感じがしてるんだと思う?

key: Anyway, just talk to Noel when you think you've found it!
en: Anyway, just talk to Noel when you think you've found it!
ja: とにかく、見つかったと思ったらノエルに話しかけて!

key: Hm? The entrance is sealed off.
en: Hm? The entrance is sealed off.
ja: ん? 入り口が封鎖されている。

key: Skip railnet train puzzle on this file?
en: Skip railnet train puzzle on this file?
ja: このファイルの鉄道パズルをスキップしますか?

key: ANNA: I'm sorry for Nostra causing so much trouble.
en: ANNA: I'm sorry for Nostra causing so much trouble.
ja: アンナ: ノストラがこんなに迷惑かけちゃって、ごめんね。

key: I dunno what's wrong with her.
en: I dunno what's wrong with her.
ja: あの子の何がいけないのか、あたしにもわからないの。

key: NOEL: Um, Nomos says that Nostra seems fine.
en: NOEL: Um, Nomos says that Nostra seems fine.
ja: ノエル: ええと、ノモスによれば、ノストラは元気そうだって。

key: But you... don't.
en: But you... don't.
ja: でも、アンナ……お前の方が。

key: HEATHER: ...
en: HEATHER: ...
ja: ヘザー: ……

key: CAIN: No matter what I do, she won't speak.
en: CAIN: No matter what I do, she won't speak.
ja: カイン: 何をやっても、あいつは口をきかない。

key: I still can't help but wonder if she's even able to, after what Dr. Geezer did.
en: I still can't help but wonder if she's even able to, after what Dr. Geezer did.
ja: あのジジイ・ドクターがやったことを思うと、そもそも話せるのかどうかすら、疑わずにはいられないんだ。

key: CAIN: You go ahead with the others, \PN.
en: CAIN: You go ahead with the others, \PN.
ja: カイン: \PN、お前は他のみんなと先に行ってくれ。

key: Heather doesn't look like she's gonna budge, so I'll stay with her and bring her along whenever we do find something.
en: Heather doesn't look like she's gonna budge, so I'll stay with her and bring her along whenever we do find something.
ja: ヘザーは動きそうにないから、オレはここに残って、何か見つかったらあいつを連れて行くよ。

key: Just make sure you don't forget about us, right~?
en: Just make sure you don't forget about us, right~?
ja: オレたちのこと、忘れないでくれよな~?

key: CHARLOTTE: Of course the path would be collapsed.
en: CHARLOTTE: Of course the path would be collapsed.
ja: シャルロット: やっぱり、道が崩れてるじゃない。

key: SHELLY: I-- I don't think that Heather is in any condition to climb over it...
en: SHELLY: I-- I don't think that Heather is in any condition to climb over it...
ja: シェリー: わ、私、ヘザーがこれを乗り越えられる状態だとは思えなくて……

key: CHARLOTTE: You got a better idea?
en: CHARLOTTE: You got a better idea?
ja: シャルロット: もっといい考えでもあるの?

key: SHELLY: Um... Um, maybe?
en: SHELLY: Um... Um, maybe?
ja: シェリー: あの……あの、あるかも?

key: I'm sure there totally won't be some complicated solution we have to find instead of just climbing over it like normal desperate people.
en: I'm sure there totally won't be some complicated solution we have to find instead of just climbing over it like normal desperate people.
ja: 普通の必死な人たちみたいに乗り越える代わりに、複雑な解決策を見つけなきゃいけないなんてこと、絶対ないと思うけど。

key: SHELLY: Um... I'd be really worried about trying to make Heather climb over this after--
en: SHELLY: Um... I'd be really worried about trying to make Heather climb over this after--
ja: シェリー: あの……ヘザーにこれを乗り越えさせようとするのは、正直心配で――

key: ...After what she's just been through...
en: ...After what she's just been through...
ja: ……あんな目に遭った後だから……

key: But, but there might be another way!
en: But, but there might be another way!
ja: で、でも、別の方法があるかもしれないの!

key: I remember reading about this place, and...
en: I remember reading about this place, and...
ja: ここについて、前に何か読んだことがあって……

key: And, um, basically, it used to be a subway for Reborn City, right?
en: And, um, basically, it used to be a subway for Reborn City, right?
ja: それで、その、これって元々リボーンシティの地下鉄だったんだよね?

key: T-this might be a little bit dangerous, but...
en: T-this might be a little bit dangerous, but...
ja: ちょ、ちょっと危ないかもしれないけど……

key: There's a chance there's a leftover train car from back then, right?
en: There's a chance there's a leftover train car from back then, right?
ja: 当時の車両が、まだ残ってる可能性もあるんじゃない?

key: CHARLOTTE: So you wanna just bust a train right through here, huh?
en: CHARLOTTE: So you wanna just bust a train right through here, huh?
ja: シャルロット: つまり、列車をここにぶっ放したいってこと?

key: SHELLY: U-um, that... That is--
en: SHELLY: U-um, that... That is--
ja: シェリー: え、えっと、それは……それは――

key: I'm just saying it's, it's theoretically--
en: I'm just saying it's, it's theoretically--
ja: た、ただ、理論的には……

key: CHARLOTTE: You are one psycho-awesome wallflower, you know that?
en: CHARLOTTE: You are one psycho-awesome wallflower, you know that?
ja: シャルロット: あんた、地味なくせにイカれたくらいすごいこと言うよね、知ってた?

key: SHELLY: H-huh?
en: SHELLY: H-huh?
ja: シェリー: え　えっ?

key: CHARLOTTE: Oh, come on.
en: CHARLOTTE: Oh, come on.
ja: シャルロット: ちょっと、やめてよ。

key: It's a compliment; don't look like I just told you you're gonna die in 48 hours.
en: It's a compliment; don't look like I just told you you're gonna die in 48 hours.
ja: 褒めてるんだから、あと48時間で死ぬって言われたみたいな顔しないでよ。

key: I was at least gonna save that for when we got out of here.
en: I was at least gonna save that for when we got out of here.
ja: それは少なくとも、ここを出てから言うつもりだったのに。

key: SHELLY: Um...
en: SHELLY: Um...
ja: シェリー: あの……

key: CHARLOTTE: All right, scouts. You all heard the madwoman.
en: CHARLOTTE: All right, scouts. You all heard the madwoman.
ja: シャルロット: よし、みんな。イカれた女の言うこと、聞いたよね。

key: Let's find a train to catch.
en: Let's find a train to catch.
ja: 列車を捕まえに行こう。

key: CHARLOTTE: ...Hm?
en: CHARLOTTE: ...Hm?
ja: シャルロット: ……ん?

key: You already found one?
en: You already found one?
ja: もう見つけたの?

key: Not bad at all, \PN.
en: Not bad at all, \PN.
ja: やるじゃない、\PN。

key: All right, take us there!
en: All right, take us there!
ja: よし、案内して!

key: ANNA: On the double!
en: ANNA: On the double!
ja: アンナ: 急いで!

key: SHELLY: What have I done...
en: SHELLY: What have I done...
ja: シェリー: あたし、何をしちゃったんだろう……

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
